title: A contrast-only interface earns a finite-horizon redesigned-task bound
statement: Let arbitrary hidden history H include rare persistent states,W indicate upstream completion,and Z be a task checkpoint. If every compatible hidden history satisfies |d(h,z)-d0(z)|<=epsilon_z for the REDESIGNED terminal contrast,then Y_cut(a)-Y_cut(b)>=E[W(d0(Z)-epsilon_Z)]. A positive lower expectation certifies preference without identifying latent mode counts/populations or observing a75-stage full success. This concerns a changed physical terminal operation,not the original E[p^74 a]. The visible diffusion route assumes known D and a uniform extra drift bound gamma over finite terminal time T,states path KL<=gamma^2 T/(4D),and uses Pinsker plus initialization/decoding errors for per-action outcome errors;contrast errors add. The original note specifies reference noise sqrt(2D),eta_v=min(1,rho+chi+gamma sqrt(T/(8D))),and contrast error eta_a+eta_b. These are worst-case all-hidden-state bounds,not fitted averages. Finite binary-outcome decision combines two sampling radii with separately physically qualified action errors. The illustrative3100/5000 versus2500/5000,delta=.01,eta_a=eta_b=.02 gives reported contrast.1200,total uncertainty.0890,margin+.0310. This is arithmetic illustration only;the separately supplied checker is acquired but not executed by Capital,and the physical bounds remain unqualified. Original note gives the illustrative margin.031045,not experimental evidence.

requires: For every hidden history compatible with a reachable checkpoint,the redesigned action contrast must be uniformly within epsilon_z of a reference d0(z). This is a physical all-state bound,not an average fitted from short assays.

Any diffusion/error reduction and finite decision test needs its stated noise normalization,finite duration,initialization/decoding/sampling contract. The redesigned carrier/interface must preserve the consequential task.
